name: gogs
description_en: The painless way to host your own Git service
readme_excerpt: 👉 Deploy on DigitalOcean and get $200 in free credits ! 🔮 Vision The Gogs (/gɑgz/) project aims to build a simple, stable and extensible self-hosted Git service that can be set up in the most painless way. With Go, this can be done with an independent binary distribution across all platforms that Go supports, including Linux, macOS, Windows and ARM-based systems. 📡 Overview - Please visit our home page for user documentation. - Please refer to CHANGELOG.md for list of changes in each release…
